Light palette.
Blue-black soul.

The quiet confidence of blue-black typography. Cool Latte surfaces, vivid blue accents, and a clearer text hierarchy — this is Iced Americano.

Explore the colors ↓Install a port ↓

A familiar surface. A sharper voice.

Calm, not washed out.

Base, Mantle and Crust stay true to Latte. Blue-black Text and stronger secondary tones give the light palette its own identity.

// A small taste of the palette
const coffee = {
  name: "Iced Americano",
  surface: "Latte",
  mood: "quiet confidence"
};
takeASip(coffee);

Color is only one cue.

This experimental palette is designed with protanopia and deuteranopia distinctions in mind, but has not undergone structured evaluation with color-vision-deficient users. It is not accessibility certification.

Not every swatch is suitable for normal text. Blue, Subtext0 and Red fall below 4.5:1 on Mantle and Crust; Green falls below 4.5:1 on Crust. Yellow, Pink and Teal ANSI text fall below 4.5:1 even on Base. Use Text or Subtext1 on darker surfaces, and explicit labels or icons for status.
